allowlist.reason: A layout sentence, not a component: a glyph and its words in a row that may be cut short. Fourteen unrelated places hold it (pickers, headers, panels and three @convergence/ui parts), each around different content.
A layout sentence, not a component: a glyph and its words in a row that may be cut short, at the tighter gap small text takes.
A layout sentence, not a component: a row's trailing cluster (actions, badges) that keeps its width while the words beside it shrink.
A layout sentence, not a component: a cluster that keeps its width while the words beside it shrink, at the wider gap.
A layout sentence, not a component: a column that fills its parent and lets one child scroll.
A layout sentence, not a component: words at the start and something at the end, top-aligned, in cards and popovers whose contents differ.
A layout sentence, not a component: words at the start and a control at the end, centred on each other.
A layout sentence, not a component: a label at the start and its control at the end, at the tighter gap.
A layout sentence, not a component: a row of controls or chips that wraps when it runs out of room.
A layout sentence, not a component: a row of small chips that wraps when it runs out of room, at the tight gap.
